name: Annotate
description: Span and document-level annotation. In a workspace, annotators work through durable queues on tasks somebody created. In a pipeline, one pass over whatever the previous step produced, kept in the browser.

config.label: Task name
config.help: Only for a session platform, which has one task and no screen to make another. With storage, tasks are named when they are created.

config.label: Labels
config.help: Only for a session platform. With storage, labels are a labelset, made once and reused by any number of tasks.

config.label: Annotation level
config.help: Only for a session platform. With storage, each task chooses its own.

config.label: Number of annotators
config.help: Only for a session platform, where annotators are positions rather than people. With storage they are named by email when a task is created.

config.label: Guidelines URL
config.help: Only for a session platform. With storage, each task carries its own link.
